name: Economics and Science for Environmental Sustainability
about: Economics, management and science for sustainability: microeconomics, marketing and maths alongside energy economics, environmental law, ecosystems, Earth systems and climate change.

name: Physical Sciences for Innovative Technologies
about: Physics applied to technology, run jointly with the University of Pavia: green energy, quantum technologies and digital innovation, with hands-on labs and some online learning.

name: Economics
about: Economics on a strong quantitative base: statistics, maths, machine learning and econometrics applied to growth, inflation, inequality, health and climate.

name: Finance
about: How the financial system works: capital markets, intermediaries, contracts and instruments, with a data-driven approach to financial decisions and risk.

name: International Politics and Government
about: Political science in a small international class: politics, economics, management, law, history and quantitative methods, focused on designing and evaluating public policy.

name: International Politics and Government, HEC-Bocconi double degree
about: Social science with in-depth data science and quantitative methods: three semesters at Bocconi and three at HEC Paris, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.

name: Management
about: How organisations plan, organise and manage their resources, across business functions such as logistics, marketing and finance, and across company types and markets.

name: Management and Computer Science
about: Maths, statistics and computing for managers who use data: acquiring, organising and analysing data to support economic, managerial and financial decisions.

name: Management for the Arts and Cultures
about: Management and economics combined with the arts and humanities, for museums, heritage, performing arts, publishing, music, film, fashion and design.

name: Mathematical and Computing Sciences for Artificial Intelligence
about: Mathematics, computer science, physics and economics combined to build the tools behind artificial intelligence, for strongly maths-minded students.

name: World Bachelor in Business
about: A four-year business degree with USC Marshall and HKUST: year one in Los Angeles, year two in Hong Kong, year three in Milan, year four at your choice of the three.

name: Bachelor in Global Law
about: Law for international advisory roles, mixed with business management, finance, economics and digital technology, with a focus on the global side of legal issues.

name: Business Administration and Management
about: Business administration and management taught in English in Venice, with double-degree options.

name: Digital Management
about: Management for the digital economy, taught in English at Ca' Foscari's Roncade campus.

name: Economics and Business
about: Economics and business taught in English in Venice.

name: Computer Science (Data Science curriculum)
about: Computer science at the Mestre science campus; the degree runs in Italian and English, with a Data Science curriculum taught in English.

name: Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism
about: Hospitality and tourism combined with digital innovation, taught in English between Venice and Mestre.

name: Ancient Civilizations for the Contemporary World
about: An inter-university degree in English on the ancient world and its meaning today, taught between Milan and Venice.

name: Italian and Mediterranean Studies
about: Italian and Mediterranean studies taught in English in Venice; first intake 2026/2027.

name: Philosophy, International and Economic Studies
about: Philosophy combined with international and economic studies, taught in English in Venice, with double-degree options.

name: Business and Finance
about: Business and finance for small and medium-sized firms, with data science, analytics and AI in business, on the Brescia campus.

name: Communication Management
about: Sociology, psychology, political science, economics and media studies applied to communication, including fashion, food and lifestyle, with labs and workshops.

name: Criminology
about: Sociology, psychology and political science with criminal law, justice systems, crime prevention and security studies, plus data analysis for crime research.

name: Economics and Management
about: Economics and finance, management and strategy, law and political economy, and maths, statistics and data tools, with internships and study abroad.

name: Finance
about: A finance degree taught in English by the School of Banking, Finance and Insurance Sciences on the Milan campus.

name: Food Production Management
about: Managing food production, taught in English by the School of Agricultural, Food and Environmental Sciences on the Piacenza campus.

name: International Business Management
about: International business on the Piacenza campus, with an optional double degree: two more years at a partner university in France, Germany, Spain, the USA or Mexico.

name: International Relations and Global Affairs
about: Political science and international relations with history, regional studies, international economics, international law and global institutions, plus projects with institutions.

name: Psychology
about: Cognitive and developmental psychology, neuroscience, clinical and social psychology, and research methods, with labs, seminars and an optional research honours track.

name: Medicine and Surgery (Rome)
about: Six-year medical degree in English with training inside Rome's Gemelli Hospital from the early years, aligned with international standards such as the USMLE.

name: Medicine and Surgery (Bolzano)
about: Six-year medical degree with lectures in English and clinical internships in German and Italian, taught with faculty from Bolzano and Rome's Gemelli Hospital.

name: Business Administration
about: Business economics with management, finance, law, quantitative methods and IT, taught in English with an international, multidisciplinary outlook.

name: Economics and Business
about: Economics, management, finance, law and quantitative methods, with particular attention to European institutions, market regulation, competition and antitrust.

name: Global Law
about: Law for cross-border careers in multinationals, NGOs and European and international organisations, with economics, management and tech, focused on global governance and human rights.

name: Management and Artificial Intelligence
about: Management and economics combined with quantitative and IT skills, to apply AI, big data and machine learning to business decisions and strategy.

name: Politics: Philosophy and Economics
about: Philosophy, politics and economics with law, history, sociology and quantitative methods; a third-year track in AI, sustainability or fundamental rights.

name: Architectural Design (English track)
about: Designing architecture at every scale, from history, representation and maths to building technology and conservation, in design studios; English tracks in Milan and Piacenza.

name: Civil Engineering (English track)
about: Planning, design, construction and upkeep of structures and infrastructure such as bridges, tunnels, dams, water systems and transport networks, on a base of maths and physics.

name: Engineering Science
about: A broad engineering degree: a common core of maths, physics, chemistry, materials and computing, then you gradually choose a field instead of committing on day one.

name: Industrial Engineering
about: Manufacturing, automation, logistics and digital innovation, taught in three terms a year with labs, projects and industrial partners on the Piacenza campus.

name: Process Engineering
about: Designing and optimising industrial processes that turn raw materials into chemicals, energy, food and medicines, with automation, data analytics, AI and digital twins.

name: Interaction Design
about: Designing apps, websites, smart devices and IoT systems that mix digital and physical parts, with user research, prototyping and programming, in Lecco.

name: Architecture (English-taught)
about: Architectural design for better places to live: designing simple civic buildings, surveying modern and historic buildings, and working on projects from concept to construction.

name: Automotive Engineering (entirely in English)
about: The motor vehicle as a system: its main sub-systems and how it is produced, for designing automotive components in teams; home of a long-running Formula SAE student team.

name: Civil and Environmental Engineering
about: Design, management and upkeep of bridges, dams, roads, railways and water networks, plus the circular economy and plants that treat industrial waste.

name: Computer Engineering (entirely in English)
about: Designing and managing complex digital systems and judging alternative IT solutions, working with other engineers and disciplines to keep technology user-centred.

name: Electronic and Communications Engineering
about: Communications, electronics and computer science together: maths and physics first, then electronic systems, algorithms, digital transmission and computer networks.

name: Mechanical Engineering (entirely in English)
about: A broad technical and scientific base in industrial engineering with mechanical specialisation, for design, production, management, automation and aerospace.

name: Applied Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
about: Applied computing and artificial intelligence on a base of maths, physics and statistics, with third-year options, economics or law, and an internship.

name: Bioinformatics
about: Biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology, medicinal chemistry and computer science combined, ending with computational biology, machine learning and an internship.

name: Business Sciences
about: How modern businesses and financial systems work, across economics, management, finance and law, for consulting and management roles.

name: Economics and Finance
about: Economic and financial markets, statistics and forecasting, and the effects of public policy; the English path of a degree that also runs three Italian paths.

name: Classics
about: Ancient Greek and Latin with archaeology, art history, law, philosophy and science, reading the Greek and Roman world as part of today's heritage.

name: Global Humanities
about: A flexible humanities and social science degree: history, anthropology, literature, media, law, human rights, migration and gender studies, and more.

name: Molecular Biology, Medicinal Chemistry and Computer Science for Pharmaceutical Applications
about: Molecular biology, medicinal chemistry and computer science together, aimed at how drugs and other active compounds are discovered and developed.

name: Sustainable Building Engineering
about: Civil engineering for sustainable buildings: low energy demand, passive design, recycled materials, longer building life and urban renewal, on the Rieti campus.

name: Nursing (Azienda Ospedaliera Sant'Andrea)
about: A three-year nursing degree taught in English, with clinical training at Rome's Sant'Andrea hospital.

name: Medicine and Surgery "F"
about: Sapienza's six-year medical degree taught in English, leading to the degree in Medicine and Surgery.

name: Dentistry and Dental Prosthodontics
about: A six-year dentistry degree taught in English, covering oral and maxillofacial sciences and dental prosthetics.

name: Building Construction Engineering
about: Between engineering and architecture: designing, building and restoring buildings, on an international programme taught entirely in English in Ravenna.

name: Business and Economics
about: Business and economics in English in Bologna, using data and analytics to shape strategies for companies, institutions and communities; double-degree options.

name: Economics and Finance
about: Economics and finance taught entirely in English in Bologna, looking at how global markets work and what they mean locally.

name: Economics of Tourism and Cities
about: Economics applied to tourist destinations and cities: analysing and rethinking strategies and policies for urban life and sustainable tourism, in Rimini.

name: Economics, Politics and Social Sciences
about: Economic, political and social questions in a globalised world, studied together in English in Bologna across economics and political science.

name: Genomics
about: Biotechnology focused on the genome: investigating the biological bases and processes that regulate life, taught in English in Bologna.

name: International Studies
about: International relations for roles in peace, cooperation and sustainable development: how international systems work, taught in English in Forlì.

name: Management and Economics
about: Tools, methods and quantitative analysis to help companies compete on global markets, taught in English in Forlì with double-degree options.

name: Pharmacy
about: A five-year pharmacy degree in English that combines science with patient contact, for work across the pharmaceutical supply chain.

name: Medicine and Surgery
about: A six-year medical degree taught entirely in English in Bologna, training doctors to practise in an international setting.

name: Veterinary Medicine
about: A five-year veterinary degree in English: caring for animals to protect people and the environment, at the Ozzano dell'Emilia campus near Bologna.

name: International Politics, Law and Economics (IPLE)
about: The University of Milan's first bachelor's taught entirely in English: international politics, law and economics combined, taught in person in central Milan.

name: Medicine and Surgery – International Medical School
about: Milan's six-year medical degree taught in English; the first-year course usually begins in mid-October.

name: Animal Care
about: Professional care, husbandry and welfare of animals, with field visits to zoos, rehabilitation centres and research facilities, at the Agripolis campus near Padua.

name: Biology of Human and Environmental Health
about: A joint degree with the University of Bologna on how human health and the environment interact; two years in Padua, then a Human Health (Padua) or Environmental Health (Bologna) path.

name: Earth and Climate Dynamics
about: Earth system science across solid Earth, oceans, climate, atmosphere, hydrosphere and biosphere, mixing classroom teaching with field work.

name: Economics, Governance and Decision-Making
about: A transdisciplinary degree in the style of Philosophy, Politics and Economics (PPE) programmes, taught in English; the first semester is entirely online.

name: Information Engineering
about: Physics and maths foundations plus the core of information engineering: control systems, electronics, telecommunications and computer science.

name: Psychological Science
about: Psychology in English in Padua, giving theory and experimental and clinical work equal weight, with seminars and workshops.

name: Techniques and Methods in Psychological Science
about: An online psychology bachelor's in English covering the main psychological domains, taught remotely by Padua's Department of General Psychology.

name: Medicine and Surgery
about: A six-year medical degree taught in English in Venice; places are set nationally, through a national admission test.

name: Comparative, European and International Legal Studies (CEILS)
about: Law taught entirely in English with a comparative, European and international approach, plus a second European language; international students must take Italian.

name: Computer Science (English track)
about: How to process, store and transmit information: maths, programming, algorithms, systems and data in the first two years, then subjects of your choice; runs in Italian or English.

name: Computer, Communications and Electronic Engineering (English track)
about: Computer engineering, communications and electronics on a base of maths, physics and programming, strongly project- and lab-based; runs in Italian or English.

name: Business & Management
about: An undergraduate business and management degree taught in English by Turin's Department of Management.

name: Economics and Finance with Data Science
about: Economics and finance combined with data science, taught in English by the Department of Economics, Social Studies, Applied Mathematics and Statistics.

name: Global Law and Transnational Legal Studies
about: Global and transnational law taught in English by Turin's Department of Law.

name: Medicine and Surgery (MedInTO)
about: Turin's six-year medical degree taught in English (MedInTO), run by the Department of Clinical and Biological Sciences.
